name: view_difficulty_hub_words
description: The level's words in the hub (M8, design 2.6 and 5.2, contract-m8 §3): beside the arch's mode line three words, Normal · Hard · Very Hard, the shown level lit; offline a click on Hard picks it (Session.set_difficulty), lights it, and the mode line names it ('High Water · Hard · 1–4 players · 12 waves'); each word's tooltip says what the level changes in numbers, read from the rules ('Hard: creeps have 10% more health, the bosses 50% more and 1 more armour; 15 lives'); in Undertow the words grey, none lit, with 'A duel is played at Normal: your rival sets the pace', and a click picks nothing, the mode line naming no level; Tide Race takes one again. A member of Ana's party sees the party's level lit, not her own, and her clicks on the words answer nothing; as leader of the party of one left, her click goes to the party.

steps.assert: node('HubPanel').level_words() == 'Normal (lit) | Hard | Very Hard' and node('ModeLine').text == 'High Water · 1–4 players · 12 waves'
steps.msg: offline, Normal lit, and the mode line names no level at Normal

steps.assert: node('Level_hard').tooltip_text == 'Hard: creeps have 10% more health, the bosses 50% more and 1 more armour; 15 lives' and node('Level_very_hard').tooltip_text == 'Very Hard: creeps have 15% more health, the bosses 55% more and 1 more armour; 10 lives' and node('Level_normal').tooltip_text == 'Normal: the creeps and the bosses as the game was tuned; 20 lives'
steps.msg: each word's tooltip says what it changes, by the rules' numbers

steps.assert: node('HubPanel').level_words() == 'Normal | Hard (lit) | Very Hard' and node('ModeLine').text == 'High Water · Hard · 1–4 players · 12 waves'
steps.msg: Hard lit, and the mode line names it

steps.assert: Session.mode_id() == 'undertow' and node('HubPanel').level_words() == 'Normal (greyed) | Hard (greyed) | Very Hard (greyed)' and node('Level_hard').tooltip_text == 'A duel is played at Normal: your rival sets the pace'
steps.msg: in Undertow the words grey, none lit, and say why
the duel's mode line names no level
a click on a grey word picks nothing

steps.assert: node('HubPanel').level_words() == 'Normal | Hard (lit) | Very Hard' and node('ModeLine').text.begins_with('Tide Race · Hard · ')
steps.msg: Tide Race takes the level again

steps.assert: node('HubPanel').level_words() == 'Normal (fixed) | Hard (fixed) | Very Hard (lit) (fixed)' and node('ModeLine').text.begins_with('High Water · Very Hard · ')
steps.msg: a member sees the party's level lit, not her own Hard
her click answers nothing: no pick, nothing sent
leading the party of one left, the words answer her again
and her click goes to the party
